issues.where: rain across the sky and field, especially the left half and the skyline
issues.what: The nearly parallel white streaks have a similar look in front of both the sky and the field, so much of the rain reads as a layer over the image rather than as depth in the scene.
issues.fix: Vary streak width, length, contrast and focus by distance, and better connect the rain near the ground to visible impacts on the mud and water.

issues.where: crops 7–8, large grass tuft at the left and smaller tufts behind it
issues.what: The grass blades are smooth, straight tapered strips with little surface detail, and the same upright fan shape recurs in the field.
issues.fix: Vary the tuft silhouettes, blade bends and widths, and add fine veins and subtle wet highlights to the in-focus blades.

issues.where: crop 6, where the main stem meets the soil
issues.what: The stem reads as a blunt cylinder set on top of a dark patch of mud. The soil does not visibly wrap around or obscure its lower edge.
issues.fix: Sink the base slightly into the mud and break up its lower silhouette with overlapping soil grains and tight contact shading.

issues.where: crops 3–4, front and backlit leaf margins
issues.what: Some margins have thick-looking triangular sawteeth, while the thin areas between veins stay dark and opaque even against the bright sky.
issues.fix: Vary and taper the teeth, add slight edge curl, and let more backlight through the thin tissue between the veins.
